sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Madan Gopal Vyas
Order 19/05/2023

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.174/2022 of Police Station Sadar Pali, District Pali for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366A/120-B, 376 of IPC and Section 3/4, 16/17 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
2.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that petitioner has not committed the offence as alleged against him.

It is also submitted that in the statements of prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.,
she has admitted that she has travelled with the petitioner at various places viz. Pali, Jaipur,
Jodhpur, Beawar, Ahmedabad, Pune and, therefore, it is submitted that relationship between the petitioner and the prosecutirx was consensual.
The accused-petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take long time.
[2023/RJJD/016547] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-3182/2023] Therefore, it is prayed that the accused-petitioner may be enlarged on bail 3.

Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submitted that in the Bhika Ram @ Vikram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/016547) on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2739451/
1 statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. of the prosecutrix, she has specifically made allegations against the petitioner that he has committed rape.

entities.text: Bhika Ram @ Vikram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/016547)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of commission of offence, therefore, petitioner may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and after perusing the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., without commenting on merits and demerits of the case, I am not inclined to grant bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. to the petitioner at this stage.
5. Accordingly, the bail application preferred by the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is rejected.

However, learned trial Court is directed to expedite the trial of the case.
6.
A copy of this order be sent to learned trial Court through e- mail or fax.

(MADAN GOPAL VYAS),J 16-Bharti/-
